title: Bagasse bioelectricity market design in Brazil: derived BIOMASSA_ACL series and document log
description: Derived monthly series of installed capacity, physical guarantee and generation of ACL-participating biomass plants (CCEE dataset BIOMASSA_ACL, October 2023 to July 2026), processing scripts and the log of regulatory and judicial documents reviewed, supporting a manuscript submitted to Utilities Policy. Primary source: CCEE Dados Abertos (CC BY 4.0).
